manifest.description: Map `mix dialyzer --format=short` warnings to defs by line and category via elixir_dialyzer_attribution. v1 is report-only — success-typing warnings have ambiguous remediation; operator consumes the categorized counts.
when_to_use: post-refactor sanity check that dialyzer warnings didn't increase
diagnostic: triage dialyzer warnings by category before deciding which to address
anti_patterns: do not expect auto-fix — dialyzer success-typing warnings often have multiple valid remediations
do not skip the PLT warmup step — dialyzer needs a built PLT to produce meaningful output (operator concern)

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-dialyzer-attribution. Report-only.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_dialyzer_attribution", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"dialyzer_short": "..."}).
2. Surface warnings categorized by {no_return, pattern_match_cov, call_to_missing, unused_type, extra_range, other}.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<warning total + category breakdown>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{dialyzer_short}}
